claims.assertion: Mari recounts the official history that Lyrians fled an Orion invasion and founded a Taygetan settlement on Temmer after a 300-year search.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She questions the stated 850,000-year date and conflicting origins.

claims.assertion: Mari describes Temmer as a water-covered, 0.8-g world with stable weather, warm climate, fertile islands, and few predators.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says the Taygetan population is concentrated there.

claims.assertion: Mari says Toleka uses underground zero-point reactors for a wireless power grid, electric vehicles, and elevated maglev trains.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says vehicles draw power without batteries.

coverage_gaps: other Taygetan planets, including military outpost Dakote
